summary: Started bounded packaging repair v0.1.2 per R2 contract gate U2 allowance ('documented v0.1.1 pyc findings are acceptable OR bounded packaging v0.1.2 repair'). Finding source: EX-INFRA3-U2-OUTENEMY-READINESS-R1 machine-reproduced the defect on the external platform - fresh git-archive export of nanolab-components-v0.1.1 fails reproduce.py verify with EXACTLY 7 errors, all 'missing file: convention/nlbl_convention/__pycache__/*.cpython-310.pyc' (0 non-pyc errors). Root cause: card_lint._package_files walks the packaging directory including CPython __pycache__ artifacts generated on the author machine during the v0.1.1 build; the .pyc files are not git-tracked and exist nowhere in the tree, so verify fails fail-closed (exit 3) on ANY fresh copy. Repair scope (packaging-only, science byte-identical): (1) card_lint._package_files excludes __pycache__ directories and *.pyc files - single choke point for manifest_create and manifest_verify; (2) releases/nanolab-components-v0.1.2 = copy of v0.1.1 with ONLY VERSION/README.md/CITATION.cff/reproduction/README.md version surfaces changed and RELEASE_MANIFEST.json regenerated by card_lint.manifest_create (not hand-edited); convention/, cards, RIGHTS, schemas, protocols stay byte-identical to v0.1.1; (3) regression test for the pyc filter. Acceptance rule: fresh git-archive export of v0.1.2 passes reproduce.py self-test verify with ok=true, 0 errors; card_lint package ok; full unittest suite green. HARD BOUNDARIES: v0.1.1 remains an immutable historical release (superseded for distribution only); frozen package F2 untouched; zero scientific runs; canonical statuses untouched; merge = Human Gate.
